message.content:
Paragraph 16 of rbi-13157 states exactly: "If a Term Deposit (TD) matures and proceeds are unpaid, the amount left unclaimed with a bank, shall attract rate of interest as applicable to savings account or the contracted rate of interest on the matured TD, whichever is lower."

The clause matches this requirement exactly. Let me confirm with compare_clause.
